annotations.text:
Four questions, all four now decided (2026-08-27).

Q1's answer sharpened in review: the threshold is per-DISCIPLINE, and whether a given discipline flags at all is the organisation's call — not a default we get to be confident about.

Q4 is a live bug: the lens already writes workspace-wide from the topbar.

Still not built — these are the agreed shape, not shipped code.

One thing deliberately left open: whether a 'declared %' belongs on a finding at all. Keeping it contradicts the settled 'no % in findings' rule, so the case is argued on the Q1 board rather than assumed.
